sections.title: 1. EXP & Leveling Guide (Lv. 1–99)
sections.summary: Fastest EXP progression brackets, DMW EXP mechanics, and why M8-6-4 Scissor Chitins dominates endgame leveling.

blocks.heading: Early to Midgame (Lv. 1–40)
blocks.body: Crisis Core ties level-ups to hidden EXP + DMW triple-number rolls (7-7-7). Progress M1, M3, M4, and M7 missions early; once you unlock Status Ward + Hell Blizzaga, wipe 6–7★ encounters in seconds.

blocks.heading: Endgame EXP (M8-6-4 Scissor Chitins)
blocks.body: Equip Costly Punch + Brutal or Genji Glove (or Buster Sword at 23%+ proficiency) and loop M8-6-4 (Scissor Chitins) or M9-6-x encounters. High-level enemies feed huge hidden EXP so DMW 7-7-7 triggers frequently.

sections.title: 2. SP & Gil Farming Master Guide
sections.summary: Mog's Amulet + Jeweled Ring economy break, M9-5-3 Three Stars, M6-6-3 Lesser Worms, and Minerva's 99x Phoenix Downs.

blocks.heading: Mandatory Farming Gear
blocks.body: Buy Mog's Amulet (10,000 Gil, Sector 7 Shop via M4-4-3) so enemies always drop Rare Drops, and Brigand's Gloves (10,000 Gil) for 100% Steal/Mug success. In Online Shop Shade (M9-5-4), buy Jeweled Ring (10,000 Gil) to double item/Materia drop quantity and Precious Watch (10,000 Gil) to double Gil earned from battles.

blocks.heading: M9-5-3 (Three Stars) & Minerva
blocks.body: M9-5-3 is the #1 SP and Gil farm in Reunion—Three Stars and Tycoon yield massive SP plus sellable Mythril Armlets and Tri-Thundaga. If you already unlocked M9-6-6, Mug Minerva for 99x Phoenix Downs (495,000 Gil per run) and flee or die to repeat.

sections.title: 3. Stat Fusion Material Farming & 98/980% Pipeline
sections.summary: Reunion changes (no repeat clear rewards), M7-2-1 Item Fusion Tome, Potion HP% rule, M6-6-3 Dark Matter, and 98/980% Libra conversion.

blocks.heading: Reunion Difference: No Repeatable Clear Rewards
blocks.body: Unlike PSP, Crisis Core Reunion only awards Mission Clear Rewards once. Instead of re-clearing missions for 99 items, farm Dark Matter from Lesser Worms in M6-6-3 (with Mog's Amulet) and convert +98 MAG Libra Materia into any stat!

blocks.heading: Consumable Potion HP% Rule
blocks.body: Clear M7-2-1 in Chapter 4 for the Item Fusion Tome. Consumables (Potion, Hi-Potion, Ether, Elixir) ONLY amplify an EXISTING matching stat bonus on one of the two Materia! Two +0 Materia + 99 Potions = +0%. Fuse an HP Up (+10% HP) with cheap 50 Gil Potions (20 = +10% HP) first.

blocks.heading: The 98 / 980% Conversion Loop
blocks.body: Never push an intermediate Libra transfer Materia to +99 or +999%—stop at +98 (or +980% HP). Then fuse that +98 Libra with your target skill (e.g., Costly Punch, Curaga, Aerial Drain) plus just ONE Hero Drink / Adamantite / Mythril / Fat Chocobo Feather to switch the stat and hit max cleanly.

sections.title: 4. Materia Leveling & Complete 18-Image DMW 100% Guide
sections.summary: Exact hidden EXP & slot 1–6 reels, Moogle Power (M8-4-4), M1-1-1 AFK loop, and unlocking all 18 DMW entries.

blocks.heading: How Materia Leveling & DMW Memories Work
blocks.body: DMW reels spin continuously during battle. Matching numbers 1–6 level up the Materia in that slot; triple matches give +2/+3 levels. Character DMW % advances as you view each character's 6 memory scenes (skipping them still counts!). Summons/Chocobo Modes jump straight to 100% after triggering once.

blocks.heading: M1-1-1 AFK Mastering & 100% DMW Loop
blocks.body: Equip Faerie Ring (auto-Regen) + Safety Bit + 1–2 mastered Moogle Power Materia (M8-4-4) or DMW-boost Materia (from QMC+ / Shade), enter M1-1-1, and let weak troopers tap Zack while the DMW masters all 6 Materia slots and fills missing DMW memories. Remember to finish the mission so progress saves!

sections.title: 5. Magic Pot Complete Encounters Guide
sections.summary: Exact locations and attack sequences for every Magic Pot encounter, including M10-2-3 (DMW) and M7-6-6 (Genji Shield).

blocks.heading: M10-2-3: Unlock Magic Pot DMW (Do This First!)
blocks.body: Equip Jump, Fira, Gravity, and Assault Twister. Enter M10-2-3 (Master Tonberry), dodge Tonberries until Magic Pot appears, do NOT attack it blindly—wait for its speech bubbles and cast Jump -> Fira -> Gravity -> Assault Twister in order.

blocks.heading: M7-6-6: Obtain Genji Shield
blocks.body: Equip Gil Toss, Costly Punch, Break Damage Limit (Brutal/Genji Glove/Buster Sword 23%+), and Octaslash Materia (Research Dept. QMC+). In M7-6-6, perform: Gil Toss -> Costly Punch -> 99,999 Damage -> Octaslash DMW. (Note: M2-2-6 & M2-5-4 also host early Magic Pots requesting Blizzard/Fire/Thunder/Gravity or Ultima.)

sections.title: 6. Buster Sword Proficiency & Skill Power (Reunion)
sections.summary: How the 4 Proficiency pools add up to 100%, unlocking Break Damage Limit at 23% and Barrier Pierce at 47%, plus Skill Power cancellation.

blocks.heading: 4 Proficiency Pools (100% Cap)
blocks.body: Proficiency splits across Perfect Guard in Battle Stance (31.66%), Strong Attack kills (31.66%), Command Materia kills from Battle Stance (31.66%), and Barrier-Piercing kills (5%). At 23% you unlock Battle Stance Damage Limit Break (99,999); at 47% you shatter enemy Barriers automatically.

blocks.heading: Fastest Farm & Skill Power Gauge
blocks.body: Farm Perfect Guards in M1-2-1 against rapid-fire gunners, Strong Attack & Command kills in M1-1-3 (50 Shinra Troopers), and Barrier kills in M9-6-5. Against Reunion bosses, dump Battle Stance Costly Punch into their Skill Power bar to weaken or completely cancel their Limit Breaks!

sections.title: 7. Chapter-by-Chapter Missables & 100% Checklist
sections.summary: Every permanently missable quest, shop, mail sender, and summon from Prologue to Chapter 10.

blocks.heading: Chapter 1–7 (Midgar Point of No Return)
blocks.body: Finish Fort Tamblin's 16 groups & Supply Pod Cursed Ring in Ch. 1, join all 3 Fan Clubs by Ch. 3, ace Aerith's Ch. 4 mini-games, talk to the Reporter & Silver Elite in Ch. 5, Cissnei in Ch. 6, and clear ALL Midgar NPC mission triggers before ending Chapter 7.

blocks.heading: Chapter 8–9 Critical Missables
blocks.body: In Ch. 8 Nibelheim, inspect the Water Tower via the Seven Wonders quest for the missable Phoenix DMW summon. In Ch. 9/10 Gongaga, open the outskirts chest for Research Dept. QMC+—if missed, you cannot unlock all 16 shops on that run.

sections.title: 8. Hard Mode Combat Meta & Genji Blueprint
sections.summary: Wall, Costly Punch, Aerial Drain, Status Ward + Hell-aga, and where to collect all 4 Genji pieces + Ziedrich/Heike Soul.

blocks.heading: Core Hard Mode Loadout
blocks.body: Run Costly Punch (99,999 defense-ignoring damage), Aerial Drain (i-frames + full heal), Curaga, Wall (or Genji Shield), Status Ward + Hell Blizzaga (ailment immunity + AoE Death), and Dualcast/Electrocute or Mug.

blocks.heading: Genji Gear Locations
blocks.body: Genji Helm: Online Shop Shade (M9-5-4, 1,000,000 Gil). Genji Armor: 100% DMW completion. Genji Shield: Magic Pot in M7-6-6. Genji Glove: Chest in M9-6-4. Bonus: Adaman Bangle (M7-3-6), Brutal (M7-4-6), Ziedrich (M9-5-6 chest), Heike Soul (100% of all 300 missions).

sections.title: 9. Hard Mode Superboss: Minerva (20,000,000 HP)
sections.summary: Stat requirements, Phoenix Down loop, dodging Judgment Arrow & Photon Feather, and depleting Skill Power on Hard Mode.

blocks.heading: Mandatory Pre-Fight Stats & Gear
blocks.body: Hard Mode Minerva has 20,000,000 HP, 255 ATK/MAG, and 255 SPR. Reach 255 VIT, 255 SPR, and 99,999 HP. Equip Genji Helm, Genji Armor, Genji Shield, and Genji Glove (or Ziedrich + Adaman Bangle). Bring Costly Punch, Aerial Drain, Curaga, Mug, and SP Master/Stat-stick Materia.

blocks.heading: Tactics & Judgment Arrow Counter
blocks.body: Mug her immediately for 99x Phoenix Downs and keep Auto-Raise active at ALL times—Judgment Arrow dispels Raise and hits hard, so deplete her Skill Power bar when Judgment Arrow charges, or time Aerial Drain's invulnerability frames. Use Battle Stance Costly Punch behind her back for 99,999 hits until Divine Slayer drops.

sections.title: 10. Materia Fusion Class Rules & Key Recipes
sections.summary: How Materia rank & classes determine fusion output, plus the most important Hard Mode fusions.

blocks.heading: Mastered Bonus & Class Priority
blocks.body: Fusing two Mastered Materia often bumps the resulting Materia up a grade (e.g., Fira -> Firaga). Combining Magic + Command usually yields a Command or Dark Magic ability, while Special (Purple) Materia like Libra/HP Up act as clean stat carriers without altering your primary attack skill when fused properly.

blocks.heading: Interactive Simulator
blocks.body: Use the Fusion Calc & Tracker tab to test Materia stat combinations, check Consumable vs. Mako/Stat Stone vs. Max-Tier catalyst caps, and jump directly to enemy farming spots for any catalyst.
